meta.title: Medical Facilities
meta.description: Medical care on the XLRI Delhi-NCR campus: a qualified doctor for basic health concerns such as fever and minor illnesses, with medication when needed.

title: Medical Facilities
intro: XLRI Delhi NCR Campus is equipped with essential medical facilities to ensure the well-being of its students, faculty, and staff.

photos.alt: The campus doctor at the desk in the medical room, beside the screened examination areas
The medical room's screened examination area, an IV stand and medicine cabinets

highlights.title: A doctor on campus
highlights.text: A qualified doctor is available on campus to address basic health concerns.

highlights.title: Everyday illnesses
highlights.text: Fever and minor illnesses are treated on campus, and the doctor can provide medications if necessary.

highlights.title: For everyone on campus
highlights.text: The medical facilities look after the well-being of students, faculty and staff.

notice.title: In an emergency
notice.text: The campus medical room is for basic health concerns. If you feel unwell beyond that, or need help urgently, contact the campus or emergency services.

related.label: Mobility Within Campus
related.description: The hostel gym, banks, salon and the free student shuttle.

related.label: Internal Complaints Committee
related.description: Confidential support and guidance on concerns about sexual harassment.

related.label: Counselling Services
related.description: Confidential support from the campus counsellor, and 24/7 online help through YourDOST.
